items.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And there is a specific album — “Country Preacher” — and there’s a tune on that, the title tune on that thing. And the most amazing thing happens. This was a live thing with Operation Bread Basket or something? Jesse Jackson?

ctx.x: Yeah I guess it is. And I lived out there too, I moved out there eventually. But a lot of musicians were in that area in Teaneck. But when he brought that tune in he says “listen to this,” and he started playing it. And we were just starting to get into the electronics you know, where we were using electric piano. And we had a Wurlitzer that we wanted to use. And he played this tune and we says, “yeah, let’s try it.” We rehearsed it and got it together. We went and tried it and people loved it. They loved it you…

And there is a specific album — “Country Preacher” — and there’s a tune on that, the title tune on that thing. And the most amazing thing happens. This was a live thing with Operation Bread Basket or something? Jesse Jackson?
